# scripts/Get-RunbookCoverage.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Reports avd-current-state validator checks covered or uncovered by knowledge/runbooks/*.md, and optionally generates draft runbook stubs.

Reads -Check '<name>' entries from avd-current-state's avd_deployment_validator.ps1 and compares them against resolves-checks front matter in knowledge/runbooks/*.md. With -WriteDrafts, writes up to -MaxDrafts status: draft runbook stubs for uncovered checks using the vault runbook template.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-ValidatorPath` | string | no | `(Join-Path (Split-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) -Parent) 'avd-current-state/avd_deployment_validator.ps1')` | Path to avd-current-state's avd_deployment_validator.ps1. |
| `-RunbooksPath` | string | no | `(Join-Path (Split-Path $PSScriptRoot -Parent) 'knowledge/runbooks')` | Path to the shared runbooks folder. |
| `-WriteDrafts` | switch | no |  | Write status: draft stubs for uncovered checks. |
| `-MaxDrafts` | int | no | `5` | Maximum number of draft stubs to write in one run. |
| `-Json` | switch | no |  | Emit JSON instead of a summary table. |

## Examples

```powershell
./scripts/Get-RunbookCoverage.ps1
```
```powershell
./scripts/Get-RunbookCoverage.ps1 -WriteDrafts -MaxDrafts 5
```
